name: PixelLoop
description: Decorative constellation loop with rounded-dot and 45-degree vector-stroke variants; the glyph pool includes the studio D and T initials.

keyboard: None: the graphic is decorative and never takes focus.
ariaRequirements: The decorative container and every glyph are hidden from assistive technology.
The component never enters the tab order.
a11y.reviewedNote: 2026-10-31: reviewed live in Storybook (Default, Example, ForcedColors). The root is aria-hidden with no role, every SVG has focusable="false", there are no focusable descendants and no text reaches the accessibility tree. Under prefers-reduced-motion the cross-fade stops and each cell keeps its first glyph, so the composition stays static rather than blank; animate={false} gives the same still frame. Cells swap at most every 0.6 s over a small area, well below the WCAG 2.3.1 flash threshold. Marks inherit the text colour and switch to CanvasText in forced colors. Because the loop runs indefinitely with no on-page pause, use it as a small accent beside content, not as a large hero behind reading text (WCAG 2.2.2).

governance.note: The Primary Studio reference informed the compact modular format, while original 5x5 vector cell-grid artwork, round marks, row-aware choreography, and timing establish a distinct implementation. Supports one, two, or three rows of three glyph grids.

size.description: Scales the glyphs and the equal space between them.

variant.description: Rounded dots or short, round-capped 45-degree strokes.

rows.description: Number of three-cell rows in the field.

animate.description: Runs the cross-fade cycle. Disable for a deliberate static composition.

cycle.description: Renders a single glyph cell (one row, one column) that steps through the whole glyph pool one formation at a time. Ignores `rows`.

forbiddenUse: use it to communicate loading, progress, status, or instructions.
add labels or interaction to the glyphs.
replace the stepped cross-fade with smooth motion.
